form.label: L2T - Enhanced Logon Analysis
form.description: Advanced Windows Event Log analysis with security focus and detailed logon tracking

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | stats count by computer_name | sort computer_name

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | search event_id=4624 new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" new_logon_account_name!="LOCAL SERVICE" new_logon_account_name!="NETWORK SERVICE" | stats count by new_logon_account_name | sort new_logon_account_name
index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 | stats dc(computer_name) as unique_hosts

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | stats dc(new_logon_account_name)
index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ | stats count
index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4625 | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ source_network_address!="-" source_network_address!="127.0.0.1" | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 | eval logon_description=case( logon_type=="2", "Interactive (2)", logon_type=="3", "Network (3)", logon_type=="4", "Batch (4)", logon_type=="5", "Service (5)", logon_type=="7", "Unlock (7)", logon_type=="8", "Network Cleartext (8)", logon_type=="9", "New Credentials (9)", logon_type=="10", "Remote Interactive (10)", logon_type=="11", "Cached Interactive (11)", true(), "Other (" + logon_type + ")" ) | stats count by logon_description | sort -count
index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 authentication_package!="-" | stats count by authentication_package | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ (event_id=4624 OR event_id=4625) | eval event_type=case( event_id=="4624" AND logon_type=="2", "Interactive", event_id=="4624" AND logon_type=="3", "Network", event_id=="4624" AND logon_type=="10", "RDP", event_id=="4624", "Other Success", event_id=="4625", "Failed Logon", true(), "Other" ) | timechart span=1h count by event_type

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ | eval logon_description=case( logon_type=="2", "Interactive", logon_type=="3", "Network", logon_type=="4", "Batch", logon_type=="5", "Service", logon_type=="7", "Unlock", logon_type=="8", "Network Cleartext", logon_type=="9", "New Credentials", logon_type=="10", "Remote Interactive", logon_type=="11", "Cached Interactive", true(), "Other (" + logon_type + ")" ) | eval full_username=if(new_logon_account_domain!="-", new_logon_account_domain + "\\" + new_logon_account_name, new_logon_account_name) | table datetime, computer_name, full_username, logon_description, source_network_address, workstation_name, authentication_package, process_name | sort -datetime

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 logon_type="3" source_network_address!="-" source_network_address!="127.0.0.1" | stats count by source_network_address | sort -count | head 15

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" new_logon_account_name!="LOCAL SERVICE" new_logon_account_name!="NETWORK SERVICE" | stats count by new_logon_account_name | sort -count | head 20

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ | stats count by computer_name | sort -count | head 20

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4625 failed_account_name!="-" | stats count, values(failure_reason) as reasons, values(source_network_address) as source_ips by failed_account_name, computer_name | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | eval full_username=if(new_logon_account_domain!="-", new_logon_account_domain + "\\" + new_logon_account_name, new_logon_account_name) | eval logon_description=case( logon_type=="2", "Interactive", logon_type=="3", "Network", logon_type=="10", "RDP", logon_type=="5", "Service", true(), "Other" ) | stats count, values(logon_description) as logon_types, values(source_network_address) as source_ips, earliest(_time) as first_logon, latest(_time) as last_logon by full_username, computer_name | eval first_logon=strftime(first_logon, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_logon=strftime(last_logon, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | stats count by computer_name, new_logon_account_name | eventstats sum(count) as host_total by computer_name | eval percentage=round((count/host_total)*100, 1) | sort computer_name, -count | head 50

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | stats count by new_logon_account_name, computer_name | eventstats sum(count) as user_total by new_logon_account_name | eval percentage=round((count/user_total)*100, 1) | sort new_logon_account_name, -count | head 50
